---
title: Section wrapper ids, no merge
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'div#outer > section#sec-outer'
          - 'section#sec-inner > h2#inner'
          - 'blockquote div#bq > h2#sec-q'
        - - 'section#outer'
          - 'div#sec-q'
---

Pandoc only merges a wrapper Div into its section when the heading is the
Div's first block and no later heading in the Div closes that section, and
only for Divs reached through Div nesting. This document pins three shapes
where Quarto's id swap must follow that rule: a nested same-level heading
splits `#outer` (no merge, no swap) while `#inner` merges (swapped), and a
Div inside a BlockQuote is never merged (no swap).
